verdict.rationale: Activepieces' own AI agents can pull live data from connected apps and act on it, for example summarising unread emails, so users can get AI-generated outputs from their data inside the product. Nothing documents built-in insight or suggestion features over the user's data; the user has to brief and configure an agent first. Missing for 10: a native data-insight or suggestion feature, documentation of insight generation over workspace or table data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: It searches Slack, Linear, Drive, or any of 760+ apps at the moment it needs the answer, rather than working from whatever you pasted into the instructions.
Write "summarise my unread emails every morning" and you get a drafted agent — a name, instructions, and the tools it needs
You write down the job in plain language, give it access to the apps it needs, and it handles the work as it arrives.
